Thanks,

Katherine — thanks for the quick reply, helpful asks. Quick answers:

- Tiered alerts: yes. We'll wire two alert levels into your monitoring: WARNING at 1.5% drop on golden set (email + slack), CRITICAL at 3% (email + slack + PagerDuty + automatic traffic rollback).
- Latency: we'll use Redwood runtime telemetry to compute p95/p99 and feed p99 to your SLO dashboard; p99 target will be configurable (we'll start at 1200ms as requested).
- Retention: by default evaluation results and per-request telemetry are retained for 90 days in the Console. We can extend for enterprise retention on the Private plan — I'll have Karthik add a short note for legal.

Implementation notes / technical checklist (Monica will own):
- Eval harness: add a CI job that runs new model variants against the golden set and expanded validation set, outputs pass/fail and delta metrics.
- Prompt set naming: prefix with MED_ and unique prompt_id; include versioning tag (v1, v2).
- Canary config: default 5% traffic, 4-hour watch window. Auto-rollback if CRITICAL triggered; manual rollback option for ops with audit trail.
- Regression alert channels: #cs-onboard (slack), ops-pager-duty (critical).

Monica / Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm the runbook ETA? I propose we run a dry-run with a synthetic model by 11/27 and full integration by 12/03.

Thanks,
Laura

Laura / team — attaching the integration-runbook.pdf (stub) and a short checklist. Key technical bits:

- Eval harness integration: we'll provide a Dockerized runner that pulls the golden CSV (MED_* prefix) and runs deterministic evals. Output: per-prompt score, aggregate quality, latency metrics.
- Golden vs expanded sets: golden (N=200 canonical prompts) will gate releases; expanded (N~1.2k) used for noisy monitoring and trend analysis.
- Canary orchestration: Redwood console can programmatically create a canary deployment with traffic split and scheduled health checks. We'll default to a 4-hour watch window with metric rollups every 10m.
- Rollback rule: CRITICAL if golden-set quality delta <= -3.0% OR p99 latency increases > 40% relative to baseline. On CRITICAL, system triggers an immediate rollback + create an incident in PagerDuty.
- Regression alerts: we will emit structured alerts to your slack channel with severity, delta, and link to the failing prompts.

ETA: dry-run (synthetic model): 2026-11-30; full integration test: 2026-12-03.

Attachments: integration-runbook.pdf (PDF, runbook and commands)
